artworks.title: Tranh toàn thân
artworks.description: Black/crimson/gold energy-officer bodysuit and long cloak in starship hangar

artworks.title: Chân dung
artworks.description: Confident close portrait in energy-officer armored uniform

artworks.title: Chiến đấu
artworks.description: Dynamic red-energy artillery action on sci-fi battlefield

artworks.title: Cận cảnh
artworks.description: Selena đứng tại bàn hologram chiến thuật trên cầu chỉ huy, tay trái trong ảnh chạm sơ đồ đội tàu, tay phải trong ảnh cầm tablet; khung dọc từ đùi lên, đen/đỏ burgundy/vàng/ivory.

artworks.title: Hoạt động
artworks.description: Selena kiểm tra cụm động cơ GEAR mở nắp trong hangar, tay gần máy chạm linh kiện và tay còn lại cầm bảng chẩn đoán hologram; suit kỹ thuật trắng-đen-burgundy, góc dọc toàn thân.

artworks.title: Outfit 001
artworks.description: White tailored academy uniform, red pleated skirt, dark hosiery in academy courtyard

artworks.title: Outfit 002
artworks.description: Selena seated in GEAR flight-simulator cockpit wearing ivory-white and burgundy fitted pilot suit; gloved hands hold twin controls, focused gaze toward HUD; blue instruments and cityport through canopy

artworks.title: Outfit 003
artworks.description: Black-red fashionable short dress with boots, strolling futuristic city at sunset

artworks.title: Outfit 004
artworks.description: Black and ruby gala gown, seated in orbital night lounge

artworks.title: Outfit 005
artworks.description: Wine-red silk home dress and soft ivory robe, relaxed night interior

artworks.title: Outfit 006
artworks.description: Selena walks down the steps of a futuristic shopping district at golden hour, wearing burgundy cropped jacket, ivory fitted top, short black A-line skirt, knee-high black boots, and carrying a burgundy handbag.

artworks.title: Outfit 007
artworks.description: Selena mặc váy burgundy đỏ dáng ôm ngắn, blazer trắng và giày cao gót đen; bắt tay sĩ quan cấp cao tóc bạc tại hội nghị ngoại giao, tay kia giữ tập hồ sơ, phòng hội nghị ánh sáng ban ngày.

artworks.title: Outfit 008
artworks.description: Dark charcoal-black fitted technical training suit with teal glowing trim and athletic armored sneakers, cropped flowing jacket; Suspended diagonally in zero-gravity training chamber, one bent leg, reaching hand, cool blue holograms; clearly dynamic not static

artworks.title: Outfit 009
artworks.description: Plum/violet ribbed fitted short knit dress with cream long white fur-trim winter coat, maroon scarf, dark sheer hosiery, high black boots; Snowy orbital observatory with telescope and planet in sky; standing/walking, coat billowing; planned trousers were NOT in the accepted render

artworks.title: Outfit 010
artworks.description: Sand/cream full-length fitted armoured desert flight/scout suit, russet panels and metallic protectors; dustproof gloves, rugged boots, burgundy sand cape/scarf; Striding along a dry alien canyon/outpost in dusty sunset, low forward camera; practical full coverage despite fitted silhouette

artworks.title: Outfit 011
artworks.description: Regal ivory, midnight-navy and gold sculpted futuristic ceremonial armored bodysuit with long sweeping navy cape, high ornate heeled boots; Grand fleet hall with banners, ships and gathered personnel, elegant forward walking pose; NOT tailored trousers from the pre-render proposal

artworks.title: Outfit 012
artworks.description: Sculpted metallic silver/black exosuit with icy cyan energy seams, shoulder/hip armour and high boots; translucent light-fins; Active prototype energy-core lab, holding a glowing blue energy sphere; cool cyan lights and holographic curves

artworks.title: Outfit 013
artworks.description: Flowing ivory/pearl layered light ruffle holiday dress with floral/gold embroidery and semi-sheer draped sleeves; strappy high-heeled sandals and purse; Elegant bright hanging-garden space resort; one hand on balcony rail; NOT linen top and culottes from original plan

artworks.title: Outfit 014
artworks.description: Deep navy-black one-piece practical fitted maintenance jumpsuit with red accent piping, tech straps and tool belt; work gloves, robust lace-up boots; Standing at bright crimson reactor with technical holographic controls, pointing to blue panel, engineer-worksite scenery

artworks.title: Outfit 015
artworks.description: Selena practices a floor-based mobility and flexibility drill at a futuristic training academy, wearing a white cropped zip sports top, white fitted training leggings with mesh panels and red-gold details, white-red sneakers, and a loose white warm-up jacket. One knee folds below her while the other leg extends forward; a hand steadies her on the floor, the other reaches above her head. Training displays and equipment in the background.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 16
artworks.description: Adult Selena in ivory short layered resort dress with burgundy sash, embroidered translucent cover-up, wide-brim straw hat and strapped sandals, one hand on balcony railing and another at hat, gazing out over sunlit futuristic coastal bay.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 17
artworks.description: Selena wearing an ivory-white one-piece swimsuit with fine gold trim and a sheer ivory embroidered cover-up, barefoot at the shallow turquoise shoreline of a futuristic seaside resort, one hand touching burgundy hair, the other holding sunglasses.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 18
artworks.description: Selena descends a grand marble staircase in a burgundy formal evening gown with gold embellishments and a flowing sheer train, holding a clutch and her skirt amid guests and a futuristic skyline.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 19
artworks.description: Selena in a fitted full-length ivory-white, burgundy and gold flight suit with completely covered thighs, armored boots and gloves, carrying a helmet on the launch platform beside GEAR fighters at sunset.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 20
artworks.description: Selena in a full-length fitted ivory and burgundy athletic performance suit with gold accents, extending one hand toward an orange holographic reflex target while dynamically balancing in a futuristic training arena.

artworks.title: Selena — Outfit 21
artworks.description: Selena seated cross-legged at an orbital café, wearing a sapphire blue short fitted dress, ivory light jacket and dark heels; holding teacup and open book by panoramic futuristic city window at sunset.
